Fellow Conservative,

We’ve all recently seen why it’s even more critical now that our Republican candidates win at all levels in the rapidly approaching 2022 Midterm Elections.

The radical Biden Democrats have escalated their abuse of power against the American people by pushing the so-called “Inflation Reduction Act” on Capitol Hill - which hangs another $739 billion spending boondoggle on American taxpayers to hire thousands and thousands of new IRS agents - and actually makes inflation worse as we slide further into the Biden Recession.

Fellow Conservative, as a top Republican supporter, you understand the historic need to win new GOP Majorities in both Houses of Congress - and win state and local races across the country - to sweep the radical, destructive Democrats out of power and bring Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda to a screeching halt.

Now it’s time to tell you how your Republican National Committee is planning to make that happen.

**Exceptional ground game.**

If you’re wondering what that means, let me explain. The RNC is recruiting thousands of volunteers to go door to door as well as call residents in communities across the nation.

Essentially, our unmatched data-driven ground game and a grassroots army of volunteers is spreading the Republican Party’s message in every community across the country!

Our commitment to engage with voters at the community level is how we will take back the House and Senate this November. Elections are won on the ground, which is why I am emailing you today. body:
Friend,

**Republicans’ chances of controlling the Senate have nosedived since late July. Back then, we had a 50/50 chance of flipping the Senate RED. Today, we’ve only got a 36% chance of flipping the chamber. It’s clear that the momentum now belongs to the Democrats.**

Look at just how quickly our & Democrats fortunes have revered.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=cc7a0cf7bf04421d8d0a808ee32ac3e8&_e=hd0Ep6By434zn59nQUGXWQYDJ14ileKh7bS78vnRgsdRGa_J7upoGp2g02EQyyafL7w_GSU-PHo84F3ENpWMjfFEDW5jODz6HnPVcBY2OOD-g6mnTZQMXv2vPktUJHYarZLoxzEYDoNFJ9Q5dfP1fZwqHVzV79GgnAZD0Qmsg6lvjW3WZqAYwsNbIFGi5OEmsFg5ih4FUg6CLP5Z46Ivj1dkCUIUSdDTd3w1Ow5ANdfgzLv0R3QGbH0b0kswUVe3dfvvs_zsWDH99nwx2SBgaSG0UPMD4vmzx7wk8msUiy4UWnOXEu580oHJm05qPK2EEeZ8SBqYF9bU63i2hC2kPGKzeuW2tLouX6N4AEupx4k4FFXujHN3lIiZDrl6eDgovZV1DzCG4rZTlT4r7N4u0FO2Zs2W-OQ4zqp5XappUKQLVsTsbj470jBWkPb9PBi5)

While we’d much rather be in the position Democrats are in now with 74 days until the midterms, we have time to turn things around. But not much. We’re sending you this visual today because despite all the talk of the “Red Wave,” it’s becoming clearer by the day that may never materialize.

body:
Help me start a national strike fund ✊| | | Hi there, A strikewave is sweeping the nation. Workers at Starbucks, Amazon, and many other companies are tired of being paid too little, worked too hard, and taken for granted. They see their billionaire CEOs with their $200 million yachts and think, “They have so much and I can’t even afford the doctor?” So workers are drawing on a long American tradition: withholding their labor until they get some respect. It’s incredible to see. But one thing is lacking: a national strike fund. Large, established unions have strike funds for workers, but workers who aren't in a union yet don't. That's where I come in. [**I’m starting a national strike fund — support it here!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49853297/363730865/-665148900?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzU4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWIzMzkwNy03YjI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_s8e4aHKa3gpmi1waAm3MMBR2ACycYLdjAwjLYrf0l4=&emci=22494fef-7826-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&emdi=19b33907-7b26-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&ceid=8222569) Every extra day on strike is another day that a worker is hitting their boss where it hurts most: their bottom line. Every dollar goes a long way and helps a worker stay on strike longer. For example:
* $16.36 = 1 hour (on average) of a worker's missed wages
* $122 = 1 month's average electric bill
* $130.88 = 1 day of missed wages while on strike

CEOs have billions of dollars and union-busting consultants. You, me, and these workers have each other — and there are tens of millions of us. This is just the beginning. Soon I’ll be building a website and creating ads and videos. Keep an eye out for emails from me with more information, and in the meantime, help me start the national strike fund here: [**https://www.gofundme.com/f/national-strike-fund**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49853298/363730866/-665148900?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzU4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWIzMzkwNy03YjI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_s8e4aHKa3gpmi1waAm3MMBR2ACycYLdjAwjLYrf0l4=&emci=22494fef-7826-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&emdi=19b33907-7b26-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&ceid=8222569) Thank you, -Rebecca ParsonFormer Candidate for Congress, WA-06

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61118854:6Sfeo2VwN:m:1:3331421248:9F8B0008B23BCF44B5DA1ABBC59928AC:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

subject: Why do I support Tiffany.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
|
| | | Hey Peter,

I wanted to take a minute and tell my story - _**about why I support Tiffany Smiley.**_

I grew up in a very close-knit family in a small town. Our whole family, aunts, uncles, and cousins would come over every Sunday night for dinner, and we would tell stories about our lives.

As far as I knew, my uncle was just a pilot, but I eventually learned he was a fighter pilot in the Marine Corps for over 20 years! I was always confused why he would get sad, anxious, or upset when people would ask questions.

When I was old enough, I discovered he was shot down in the Gulf War and taken prisoner for 90+ days. He was the only person on the plane to survive.

He came home after the war and hasn't been the same since.

They honorably discharged him yet never provided access to the mental health services that he needed. Care that he _earned_.

When I heard about Tiffany's story, _**I felt that there was someone out there who cared about bettering service members' lives after their time, not just during. **_

The more I read about her and listen to her interviews, the more I realize how much _our country needs a leader like Tiffany._

Tiffany Smiley not only wants to improve the lives of America's veterans but the futures of our children, the health of our economy, and to help us all achieve our American Dreams.
_**[She isn't just only a leader to want; she's a leader America needs.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119766:JLZOo2VEN:m:1:3317145305:AE2EEE5D10FCCB13A2257F5A1CB213AA:r "She isn’t just only a leader to want; she’s a leader America needs. ")**_
We're now in the final days until the General Election, and I'm encouraging you to step up NOW!

Being a Team Smiley member, I've witnessed the _incredible_ grassroots support behind this campaign. It's truly something special, and I promise you'll want to be a part of this history-making campaign.

---

TIFFANY?")
---

Tiffany Smiley is running in the #1 race to watch. She's facing 30-year incumbent Patty Murray and is promoting an optimistic message of hope for the future of America.

_Simply put, we need Tiffany in the U.S. Senate._

She never gave up on our veterans and will never give up on America, so there is no reason we should give up on her.

---
| | [DON'T GIVE UP](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119766:JLZOo2VEN:m:1:3317145305:AE2EEE5D10FCCB13A2257F5A1CB213AA:r "DON’T GIVE UP")

With your help, Tiffany can go into November prepared with the best grassroots team behind her.

Thank you for listening to my story, and, just like Tiffany - _**[don't give up.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119766:JLZOo2VEN:m:1:3317145305:AE2EEE5D10FCCB13A2257F5A1CB213AA:r "don’t give up.")**_

Best,

Anna

Friend,

We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119724:6T0Ew2VQN:m:1:3253819041:DF2D0EFB58525A7F818FFF829F4DA196:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119724:6T0Ew2VQN:m:1:3253819041:DF2D0EFB58525A7F818FFF829F4DA196:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119724:6T0Ew2VQN:m:1:3253819041:DF2D0EFB58525A7F818FFF829F4DA196:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

Friend, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent –and Friend, it’s more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I’ve worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. _**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zec4usvukieni32iln81i9vk3rvdmch1o6j45r7o_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge1o35cph2bs)**_

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that’s what this fight is all about. _**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z002t1pe0ai0d21h6cf63kuau5g45c1th2d64fm8_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge1o35cph2bs)**_

**It’s not about me, it’s not about my opponent, it’s about you – your business, your children’s education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left’s radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers’ unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist – you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I’ve only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. _**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z65ujlhnt8n5udtbbtk72ddsuqvl51ddp9oh1208_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge1o35cph2bs)**_

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business’ ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and _**[stand with me in the fight against the Left’s schemes and radical agenda.>>>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5vm89phid4bojrctahct1ojmirgivc3gqvgvp18_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge1o35cph2bs)**_

Sincerely,__

Friend, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent –and Friend, it’s more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I’ve worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. _**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4n8t48a8t75q6tlpft1und5j4d7d6pa7nadb5pg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge9o74cph2bs)**_

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that’s what this fight is all about. _**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zro7ilau30l2fm3nhn4gnaem0986udgjkvr06i68_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge9o74cph2bs)**_

**It’s not about me, it’s not about my opponent, it’s about you – your business, your children’s education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left’s radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers’ unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist – you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I’ve only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. _**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5dbloh4khj0fltkcj20uvpvmut69c26933coq00_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge9o74cph2bs)**_

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business’ ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and _**[stand with me in the fight against the Left’s schemes and radical agenda.>>>>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmjaerhk3mg037usnqasum6hc35vj1ogk2svqcbg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cdge9o74cph2bs)**_

Sincerely,__

Friend, my work in the Senate is guided by the timeless and powerful Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to repair and improve the world. So today, I want to take just a moment to share a little bit more about my faith with you.
I am the proud granddaughter of Jewish immigrants. From a young age, my family taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I learned how Jewish women have been holding our communities together and taking a stand against injustice from the time of the Torah to today.
Now, as both the third Jewish woman Senator in U.S. history, and the only former synagogue president in the U.S. Senate, **I'm proud to carry these values with me in everything I do to serve Nevada and our country.**
And in this present moment, we're facing no shortage of issues – many of which directly impact women and the Jewish community. From growing antisemitism to attacks on abortion rights, to attacks on our very democracy, I know it's my duty to respond with clear resolve and a commitment to social justice.
If we truly want to repair the world, then it’s up to all of us to come together, roll up our sleeves, and do the repairing.
**There is so much work ahead of us to make this nation better – for ourselves and for future generations.** **[So if the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you – if you're with me in the fight to make real progress for our country – I hope you'll chip in $5 or more today to help me continue this critical work in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49862669/363763692/610767770?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1979-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmZiNzY0Yi1kODI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hNqykNA6cc3R17P4l0r2G_3UhWl01wWoNH18_5SD0Fo=)**

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=05c60795c41f42038eae6b9547163892&_e=DVWak9UxvjRyvPD2wPxIJXvDwiFmNCtyoTWHjEDNgyoSUJkiNamGZYarFgVVxAYzSTu0pudGLCM1sVKZpPfGgfJIhRWildHN1yQwU5QP8Goa9JsJa2UVU1tULuvhHn9hzylTmIVfwW1-yGVgu3zttvyKGgsChtBD_OZ4jfyY4ZclQdhht5e55L3z1S2CIVeH1yt4tg-FJasegy-FHjsUQ6aSYRnh4Kgt_G7TcroOHW8L_P1gxHyRfnJgInKcAiN8P6k8rSQs-c831ZT4INMDFooV3oz6Rdecf9yt9Ca5LcDoQ7T9so-Xgbp3fST9SMNYHOulPRcyza6BpoFsRHQUiAomcXmv8MKKwmbb3tcopbOYtNTG7_d78UHCi_yr8ns8jFd-24IwnRcKgdWoqwhNQz7y4UHLEr3g0caHSiJBaAM%3D "Johnson1")**_

Harper_ — which could reinstate the extreme, illegally gerrymandered congressional maps that North Carolina's highest court threw out. body:
Hi Derek, my name is Charlie Crist, and I just became the Democratic nominee for governor of Florida.
My opponent? Gov. Ron DeSantis, one of the most dangerous Republicans nationwide.
Ron DeSantis has been using Florida as a testing ground for some of the most cruel and divisive culture war tactics of the last two years. He has been setting himself up as a likely presidential contender, and it’s been working.
DeSantis signed one of the first vile “Don’t Say Gay” bills. He attacked Disney and the Special Olympics when they opposed his policies. He’s even created an “elections police” unit that people fear will be more about voter intimidation than voter protection.
DeSantis’s next act is to run for president in 2024, and that’s why I’m writing to you today. This election is our last, best chance to stop Gov. DeSantis’s national ambitions and get Florida back on track. We can accomplish both by defeating him on November 8th, so I hope you’ll make a contribution today to split between my campaign for governor and CommonGood. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220828_CGVA_Crist]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220828_CGVA_Crist&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220828_CGVA_Crist&amount=35]

DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220828_CGVA_Crist&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220828_CGVA_Crist]
By using the governorship as a stepping stone to run for president in 2024, DeSantis has shown he doesn’t have Florida’s best interests at heart.
But I’ve always put Floridians first. From my time as a state senator to serving as Florida’s 44th governor, I’ve lived my life by the Golden Rule, working to build unity rather than fueling division.
Fortunately, Floridians are waking up to Ron DeSantis’s horrible agenda. Multiple polls have shown me either neck and neck with him or outright beating him, so I know this fight is winnable. DeSantis only won in 2018 by 0.4% in 2018. A recent Axios article said “Florida swing voters view Ron DeSantis as too extreme.”
Beating DeSantis won’t be easy, but nothing worth doing ever is.
Together, we can make Ron DeSantis a one-term governor and ensure he never steps foot anywhere near the White House. Can I count on you for a donation that will be split between my campaign and CommonGood? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220828_CGVA_Crist]
Thank you,
Charlie

name: Herschel Walker
subject: My story: one of healing, forgiveness and redemption
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61122630:J1owi2VNL:m:1:3253819041:5B12262070B288CF1390AE85B3A2649C:r)
---
Peter,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61122630:J1owi2VNL:m:1:3253819041:5B12262070B288CF1390AE85B3A2649C:r)
Democrats have already spent over $25 million on false attack ads, and that number is growing EACH DAY. Every hour that Democrats attack me without our campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, we're at a tremendous disadvantage.

**[I need your help to combat their vulgar, gutless attacks against me. Please donate to our media fund right now so we can refute the lies Democrats are peddling and set the record straight.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61122630:J1owi2VNL:m:1:3253819041:5B12262070B288CF1390AE85B3A2649C:r)**

**The silver lining of this disgusting attack is that it gives me another opportunity to highlight the importance of mental health awareness and treatment. If you're suffering, know that your life has value. You aren't alone. And I will never stop fighting for you.**

I’m sorry if this bothers you today, but if you could lend me just a few seconds of your time, it would mean the world to a combat Veteran like me.

My name is Morgan Luttrell and I’m running for Congress to drive the Democrats out of Texas and keep this great state red for a million different reasons.

_**The most important being this: if the Democrats take Texas, we’ll never win an election again.**_

Democrats and their pals on Wall Street are so rich, they think that people like you and me don't amount to a bucket of spit. They spend all of their time in Washington living like Kings, and raising millions for their campaigns while we're stuck footing the bill.

I spent most of my adult life in combat zones in Iraq and Afghanistan, and I even survived a deadly helicopter crash in 2009. When I joined the Navy, I took an oath to defend America.

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61122778:65Auc2VNT:m:1:3317145305:A97F716005A71B5234CC54232CFCE7A2:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

body:
The truth is I’m reaching out today with a request today because we have an important fundraising deadline in just a few days.
#

First and foremost, I want to say thank you to everybody who has supported our grassroots campaign. I am so grateful to the more than 100,000 people who have helped us get to where we are - less than 3 months from making history. It is humbling.
The truth is I’m reaching out with a request today because we have an important fundraising deadline in just a few days. Will you please consider making a contribution to our grassroots campaign to help us hit our ambitious goal of 25,000 donations? Please use this link to give:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-aug22?refcode=em220828-1**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220828-1-subs&t=1&akid=1567%2E357359%2E0LP8Cs)
We’re heading into the final stretch of this campaign. Right after Labor Day, everything kicks into an even higher gear. Senate Republicans’ outside spending is going to increase by millions of dollars.
Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down because this seat and our next Senator’s vote should not be for sale.
My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state, where marriage equality is overturned, and where economic inequality only gets worse.
I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. I will never hesitate to do what is right in the U.S. Senate — justice for the people will be my North Star.
But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone.
[**So I’m humbly asking you to make a $3 contribution to our campaign today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. My name is Margaret Wood Hassan. Some people call me “Senator,” two very special ones call me “mom” (more on that in a second), but most just call me Maggie. You might already know a bit about me and what I stand for. **[_If you do, I hope you’ll take a second to give even just $3 to help my campaign meet its end-of-month fundraising goal._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49875982/363815446/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1502-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTVlOWJiYS1mNzI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vza1nLN720bKc2Ea_2MWaydIWt5v307reAP3mdsp8do=)**

But no matter how much you know about me, today I want to take a moment to reintroduce myself. To that end, here are 10 things I think you should know about me.
Hi folks – I’m Maggie, and I’m running in one of the top battleground Senate races of 2022. As a part of that campaign, I wanted to share 10 things about myself with you:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49875983/363815447/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1502-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTVlOWJiYS1mNzI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vza1nLN720bKc2Ea_2MWaydIWt5v307reAP3mdsp8do=)
1\. Before I was elected **anything** , I was a mom: I’ve been a State Senator, Governor, and U.S. Senator, but before I began my life in public service I had my two wonderful kids – Meg and Ben. Advocating for kids like Ben, who has cerebral palsy, was part of what led me into public service in the first place.
2\. I’m one of **four** Margarets: My grandmother was Margaret Cooke Byers, my mother is Peggy Byers Wood, I’m Maggie Wood Hassan, and my daughter is Meg. I stand on the shoulders of each Margaret (and every woman) who came before me, and I’m committed to making a better world for young women like my own daughter Meg.
3. I am only the second woman in history to be elected both Governor and Senator: Serving New Hampshire in both roles has been the honor of a lifetime and I’m proud to share the titles of Governor and Senator with my friend and colleague Jeanne Shaheen (the _first_ woman to be elected to both roles!).
4\. In college, I played rugby: While I’m glad that politics is only a full contact sport _metaphorically_ , the teamwork and toughness rugby taught me are skills I carry with me to this day.
5. I’m the daughter of a veteran: My dad, who survived the Battle of the Bulge, instilled the importance of service in me. His example has also inspired my determined, continuing advocacy for the brave men and women who, like him, have served and sacrificed for this country.
6. My dad used to ask “What are you doing for freedom today?” at the breakfast table: With that question, he instilled in us the importance of fighting for freedom every day – not just for ourselves but for those around us. Although it’s been a while since I was a girl eating cereal at that breakfast table, I still think about those values and that question to this day.
7\. I love horseback riding: While I’m not particularly interested in the proverbial political horse race (I’m focused on delivering on the issues that matter most, not the polls) I grew up riding and caring for horses.
8. I do The New York Times Mini Crossword puzzle every morning: And sometimes I even compete with my colleagues like Amy Klobuchar.
9. I’ve got a lovable dog named Chip: Chip was originally a service dog in training who joined the Hassan family after realizing he was a little too social for the job. There’s nothing I love more than taking him for a long walk on a rail trail near our home – even though he always seems to find a way to drag me off the path and into a creek...
10. 1,017 is a number I’ve got memorized: That’s how many votes we won this seat by in 2016. Without those 1,017 votes we wouldn’t have saved the ACA or passed the Inflation Reduction Act, so I’m incredibly proud of that number. But I’m also acutely aware of the fact that it’s the slimmest margin of any sitting U.S. Senator. I end with this fact because it is not just about me, it is about all of us. subject: I was once a seasonal firefighter with U.S. Forestry Service

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Hey Derek,

I want to tell you about my favorite summer job, ever. I was a seasonal
firefighter with the U.S. Forestry Service and a group of my friends in
California in the early 1980s.

Don’t believe me? Check it out:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ][IMG]

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]Before I go on, can I ask you to chip in $10 to our campaign? I want to
share with you why this photo matters to me. But I also want to make sure
we have the resources to fight to keep the House and Senate in 2022. Can
you chip in $10?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=aug2022_abs_em.9pNUzn&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $10

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1016?c0=aug2022_abs_em.eTCtKE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $25

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1017?c0=aug2022_abs_em.igdUTL&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $50

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1018?c0=aug2022_abs_em.LRJ0bh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1009&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $100

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1019?c0=aug2022_abs_em.3a0QKW&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1010&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $250

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1011&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

I had quite a few summer jobs to help pay for college and law school. And
even then, I graduated with a lot of student debt that I paid off over the
course of more than a decade. There were some years that my student loan
repayments were more than my rent in Los Angeles... and that’s saying a
lot.

It’s why I’ve spent so much of my career focused on expanding Pell Grants
and making community college free. And it’s why I’ve pushed for President
Biden to cancel federal student loan debt.

But this summer job was also formative for me, and one reason that I’ve
spent so much of my time focused on wildfires in Congress.

After the Station Fire in 2009 in the Los Angeles Foothills (in the
northern part of my district) destroyed hundreds of structures and
resulted in the death of two firefighters, I led the charge in Congress to
investigate the cause of the fire, get resources to the Forest Service
that they desperately needed, make policy changes, and invest in wildfire
prevention before the next big one.

By the way – Here’s the “Governator” with me inspecting wreckage, and
talking to displaced residents (and yes, after finding the burned remains
of a dumbbell, Arnold could not resist a little showing off):

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1012&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ][IMG]

My experience as a seasonal firefighter, and as a Congressman representing
residents who lost their homes, has helped guide me a lot in Congress.

It’s why I fought for millions of federal dollars to buy “night-flying”
helicopters to drop water on raging wildfires and helped change Forestry
Service policy which banned night flights for decades. It’s why I led the
charge to stand up and keep running a satellite program to detect
wildfires before they get out of control and give real-time notice to
firefighters. And it’s why I’ve fought for money to combat climate change
– because wildfires are only going to get worse in coming years if we fail
to act.

While this type of work might not generate headlines or be something the
24-hour news networks deem important, it keeps people safe and makes our
communities better. And it’s the kind of work that is so critically
important to me personally.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1013&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]I want to continue this work for years to come, so I’m asking: Can you
chip in $10 to help me keep up this work and defend our majorities in
Congress this year?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=aug2022_abs_em.9pNUzn&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1014&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $10

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1018?c0=aug2022_abs_em.LRJ0bh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1017&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $100

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1019?c0=aug2022_abs_em.3a0QKW&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1018&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]EXPRESS DONATE $250

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220828_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1019&akid=612%2E5257348%2E7c_3oo ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

Thanks for all you do and remember to always thank your local
firefighters.

— Adam

This is alarming, but I need you to read:

**Don Bolduc, a far-right extremist running against me, is leading the polls in New Hampshire.** This isn't just bad news for our Senate majority – it's bad for our democracy.

Bolduc continues to push the Big Lie and baseless election fraud claims and even “promised to defy the presidential election results, should he be called upon to do so in 2024."

And that’s not all—Bolduc says he is open to abolishing the FBI and even recently called to repeal the 17th Amendment, which allows voters to elect their Senators directly.

Don Bolduc's dangerous rhetoric couldn't be more out of touch with Granite State values, and if elected, he would only drag New Hampshire backward.

With everything from reproductive rights (Bolduc said we should “rejoice” at _Roe_ being overturned) to the fate of our planet (he said climate is “not a priority”) on the line, we cannot afford to have Don Bolduc in the United States Senate.

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You'd think I was crazy. Aren't they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. body:
Let’s work together to send Peter to the Senate

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=850%2E61531%2EjNxsv1)
Hello,
At a time when our democracy is imperiled and partisan division seems worse than ever, I look to Vermont. We see people helping their neighbors, caring for their communities, and working together to solve problems. I think we need more of Vermont in DC and that’s why I’m running for Senate.

Friend -

This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also the GOP Nominee in the MUST WIN race in NC-14, a brand-new district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.

[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2rc0p6udrehhguf7d6n5jsv2o1ijeo8v9udci5g_rp22sh2s8i66or4cti6coj2cdh2bs)

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can't win this race. But I bet you've heard that one before...

I'm not the kind of guy who asks for help, but starting a grassroots campaign is tough - **really, really tough. **

The Democrats won't stop attacking us and cutting off every path to victory we have. Folks like you & me - they hate our guts.

Please have my back on this one:

****[****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvg9fo7r8orkcptubuda8mrlnklct6mug3j07cl0_rp22sh2s8i66or4cti6coj2cdh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $20**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7a4q7d1nsb3372kflaclj9o7a1m477fpr29j5lg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cti6coj2cdh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za52r6og0gf7h2jh2o60hqkl1k385s9bq3qqo0so_rp22sh2s8i66or4cti6coj2cdh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $100**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zghjlqcfg0tovroj2qrp6r7b6g0vm1ssg5toshm8_rp22sh2s8i66or4cti6coj2cdh2bs)

Look, I'm not a politician. I'm nothing flashy or special, just a regular guy who loves this country more than anything. So, I'm opening my heart to you today in hopes you'll stand with me.

I won't give you empty promises & fancy slogans. That's not me. But I'll give you my word as a veteran that I'll fight with all I have to do what's right and make you proud.

Thank you & God bless.

**Pat Harrigan**
GOP Conservative Candidate
North Carolina's 14th District

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61116045:J5LgP2VjN:m:1:3339843426:37D6B6630C194E766C9DEBBCA0915F31:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220828&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220828&amount=28]
Team,
Today, I wanted to share a story from one of our mid-Michigan summer festivals.
As I was walking in the Dewitt Ox Roast Parade a few weeks ago, a boy no older than ten came up to me with something very important to say:
“You’re Elissa Slotkin! I see you on YouTube all the time!”
He was talking about my ads ( which you can see here [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] ) that run both on television and online on websites like YouTube.
Digital advertising has skyrocketed in the past few years for campaigns. It is a great way to reach people – particularly young people – who are watching less traditional television.
And I must say, they’re quite a bit cheaper than television ads, whose prices are set by TV stations – something that has been a bit of an issue lately as stations in the Lansing area have raised their prices. Nothing we can’t handle, but a bump in the road for sure.
Five years ago, I would have laughed if you had told me kids would be seeing my face on YouTube. Now, I find myself popping up between cartoons and video clips on their phones and iPads. It’s definitely a part of being in elected office that I’ll never fully get used to.
At the end of the day, it’s because of people who chip in to my campaign that I’m able to purchase these ads. So if you’ve contributed already, thank you – and if you haven’t or would like to again, you might just be the reason I pop up on the next 10 year old’s YouTube video. name: Rep. Dan Eubanks
subject: Biden Says You Owe Over $2000
body:
Congratulations, you now owe $2,085.59! By: Rep. Dan EubanksJoe Biden believes he has the authority to unilaterally force $2,085.59 worth of someone else's personal student loan debt onto you and | |
---

| | | Congratulations, you now owe $2,085.59! |
---|---|---
| By: Rep. Dan Eubanks
|
---
Joe Biden believes he has the authority to unilaterally force $2,085.59 worth of someone else's personal student loan debt onto you and every other taxpaying American. So, in the words of Dr. Phil, ask yourself, "How does that make you feel?"
According to the National Taxpayers Union, the proposed cost of Biden's student loan forgiveness program could ultimately total around $329.1 billion over the next 10 years. This is in addition to the $32 billion of debts already forgiven. Spread this new debt across each and every taxpayer, and $2,085.59 is your personal share. You might be thinking, "Oh, but wait, that's just the national debt so it doesn't really affect me." Sadly, that line of reasoning is the very thing that enables our self-serving government officials to continue running a tab with your name on it. Since the government actually produces nothing in and of itself, the federal, state and municipal debts that are racking up at staggering rates belong to whoever is currently paying the bills. One of the most fundamental principles that exists in economics is that the government can give nothing away that it doesn't first take from someone else.
[Take the Survey - What do you think about Biden's student loan forgiveness plan?](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Surveys/8036/Respond)
Increasing the money supply, by either printing money or taking on more debt, only devalues the dollars that both you and every other American has saved or is currently being compensated with. This effect is known as inflation. For all intensive purposes, inflation is nothing more than a tax, as it effectively transfers the government's debt directly onto you. While you may not have physically written a check to the IRS, or see a deduction on your pay-stub, by devaluing your dollars through the process of inflation, you have already paid for a portion of that growing debt. I say portion, because in reality we and our future generations will continue to pay for it as long as it exists. Ultimately, that payment will come in the form of inflation or higher taxes, but usually both.
If you need a recent real world example, on average, most American households received a couple thousand dollars in stimulus payments from the government during the pandemic. It felt great getting some "free" money, right? Fast forward to 2022, and as a result of increased government borrowing and money printing, every household in our country has now paid back close to twice what they received in stimulus payments as a result of the increased costs of goods and services through inflation. Word to the wise, there is no such thing as a free lunch.
Like most things these days in our country, especially if they have to do with our federal government, what you see is seldom what you actually get. Bills with altruistic sounding names like the "Inflation Reduction Act", which hires 87,000 more IRS auditors, raises taxes on the "rich" and many businesses, and underwrites massive amounts of spending for more green initiatives, will do anything but lower taxes.
Biden's student loan forgiveness plan, touted as helping deal with education inequality and the high cost of education, does the exact opposite as well. The real inequality of this plan takes place when you transfer the debt of someone (who, through their own free will, acquired it), onto individuals who had absolutely nothing to do with it. For every taxpayer who never went to college, every parent who skimped and saved and took out loans for years to put their children through college, every student who took night classes and worked their way to a degree, those who worked two jobs after college to pay off their student loans, or the individual who refinanced their house in order to consolidate and pay off their student loan debt, their outrage should be so deafening that that politicians who support it would fear going out in public.
This entire effort will do absolutely nothing to help with education inequality or the high cost of obtaining a degree. If it did, it wouldn't just reward the irresponsible by punishing individuals who planned, worked hard, and did the right thing. The fact is, that paying off people's personal loans does nothing to fix the problem of high tuition and educational borrowing costs. How so? Next year, millions of students will enroll in classes and run up the exact same amount of debt from those very institutions with high costs that this year's students are being forgiven. In the end, the only real problem that has actually been fixed here, is solving how Joe Biden will underwrite his vote buying for a party that finds itself in an upcoming election crisis.
[Voice Your Opinion - Take the Survey](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Surveys/8036/Respond)

For every taxpayer who never went to college, every parent who skimped and saved and took out loans for years to put their children through college, every student who took night classes and worked their way to a degree, those who worked two jobs after college to pay off their student loans, or the individual who refinanced their house in order to consolidate and pay off their student loan debt, their outrage should be so deafening that that politicians who support it would fear going out in public. This entire effort will do absolutely nothing to help with education inequality or the high cost of obtaining a degree. If it did, it wouldn't just reward the irresponsible by punishing individuals who planned, worked hard, and did the right thing. The fact is, that paying off people's personal loans does nothing to fix the problem of high tuition and educational borrowing costs. How so? Next year, millions of students will enroll in classes and run up the exact same amount of debt from those very institutions with high costs that this year's students are being forgiven. In the end, the only real problem that has actually been fixed here, is solving how Joe Biden will underwrite his vote buying for a party that finds itself in an upcoming election crisis. | * | The Caucus is a political organization dedicated to promoting the ideals of individual rights, limited government and free enterprise within the state of Mississippi. | Mississippi Freedom Caucus 530 George Street, Suite 200 Jackson, MS 39202 www.FreedomCaucus.ms 662-469-6242 info@freedomcaucus.ms ---|--- You are currently subscribed to a mailing list of Mississippi Freedom Caucus. [1]Beto O'Rourke

On Thursday, the most extreme abortion ban in America went into effect
across Texas.

Greg Abbott’s dangerous law bans abortions beginning at conception. It has
no exception for rape or incest. And a full 82% of Texans oppose it.

But it’s now the law of the land in Texas — because of Greg Abbott.
Not only did Abbott choose to enact this extreme abortion ban, he is proud
of what he’s done to attack the freedom, health, and lives of Texas
women.

We must act now to defeat him and to restore the freedom of Texas women to
make their own decisions about their own body, health care, and future.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220828-1.0P5smS&refcode=ema20220828-204940&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=204940%2E444211%2EyhUNhb ]We will stop Greg Abbott, elect Beto O'Rourke, and restore the right to
choose in Texas. But it’s going to take unprecedented political activism
from all of us, so please, will you join me in this fight by pitching in
your first donation
right now?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220828-1.0P5smS&refcode=ema20220828-204940&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=204940%2E444211%2EyhUNhb ]Contribute $3

If you are furious, you are not alone.

Texans of every political background — Democrats, Republicans,
Independents, and first-time voters — are showing up and getting involved
in this election because of the extreme stakes.

But there are still millions of Texans who need to hear about Greg
Abbott’s cruelty and failure to listen to the people of Texas. That’s why
Beto’s campaign just launched our first statewide ad — to hold Abbott
fully accountable for his extreme abortion ban.

This is a people-powered campaign, and I know there are enough of us to
rise up, fight for our reproductive rights, and elect a pro-choice
governor. As my mom and former Governor of Texas, Ann Richards, would say,
I hear America singing.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220828-1.0P5smS&refcode=ema20220828-204940&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=204940%2E444211%2EyhUNhb ]But we won’t be able to defeat Abbott’s extreme attacks on Texas women
without a historic grassroots effort to reach voters in all 254 counties
of this state. Please donate anything you can today. Greg Abbott has got to
go.

This is a dark day in Texas. But I believe with my whole heart that if we
come together and put everything we have, including some dollars, into
this fight — we will win.

In solidarity,

Cecile

Cecile Richards
National Finance Chair, Beto for Texas

body:
| Peter,

**I’m so honored that Joe Cunningham has chosen me to be his running mate in the race for governor of South Carolina.**

My whole life has been about fighting for what’s right, even when it wasn’t the easiest thing to do.

When I first applied to the Air Force Academy at age 18 because I wanted to fly F-16 fighter jets, I was told that girls weren’t allowed to engage in combat. So I moved on, instead going to Princeton and then getting my law degree at the University of Virginia.

**But when that rule changed, I applied again, and ultimately became the first female fighter pilot in South Carolina, serving three combat tours in Iraq.

Now, I’m taking my fighting energy to this campaign in South Carolina, delivering for working families as your lieutenant governor.**

But here’s the thing: We’re going up against Henry McMaster, who has spent the last four years fundraising and courting the support of special interest donors.

**[That is why I am asking for your help. Now that I am a part of the team, we have to step up. clean_body: | Peter, I’m so honored that Joe Cunningham has chosen me to be his running mate in the race for governor of South Carolina. My whole life has been about fighting for what’s right, even when it wasn’t the easiest thing to do. When I first applied to the Air Force Academy at age 18 because I wanted to fly F-16 fighter jets, I was told that girls weren’t allowed to engage in combat. So I moved on, instead going to Princeton and then getting my law degree at the University of Virginia. But when that rule changed, I applied again, and ultimately became the first female fighter pilot in South Carolina, serving three combat tours in Iraq. Now, I’m taking my fighting energy to this campaign in South Carolina, delivering for working families as your lieutenant governor. But here’s the thing: We’re going up against Henry McMaster, who has spent the last four years fundraising and courting the support of special interest donors. = | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | = | = | = | = | = | = I’m proud that my young children get to see their mom breaking barriers and achieving her dreams. Today, I serve as CEO of one of South Carolina’s most esteemed law firms—a place where women make up 60% of the executive leadership team—and I’ve been recognized as one of the top 25 lawyers in the state. Now I want to bring my skills as a fighter, a litigator, and a negotiator to the halls of government, where I can do more for the people of South Carolina. As lieutenant governor, I want to champion women’s rights, make sure our kids have access to the best education possible, and provide high-quality health care to everyone, especially our veterans. Like many of you, I believe our great state isn’t living up to its full potential. We have leaders who are rejecting lifesaving Medicaid funds just to score political points, taking away women’s freedom to do what they want with their own bodies, and leaving our children behind. That’s about to change. But we can’t do it alone. = I look forward to getting to know you all better over the coming months and talking about ways to change South Carolina for the better. Heading into the 2016 election, Democrats knew that the landscape would be a difficult one to win in. But my team came out of the gate strong, raised grassroots dollars, knocked on thousands of doors, and in an otherwise sobering, awful election, we were able to buck national trends and flip this seat.
Now, Democrats are facing what is perhaps an even more difficult environment. So to keep this seat that the Democratic Senate majority hinges on, we’ll need to defy the odds again. But we won’t do that with luck. Instead, we’ll do it by hard work, detailed planning, and (as is the reality of political campaigns) strong fundraising.
**[So if you can contribute $3 to help us hold this seat, and with it our Senate majority, please do. If Democrats lose here, it will pave Mitch McConnell’s path back to the majority Leader’s office.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49881098/363835770/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1501-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMjU4YWNlMi0xMDI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hwyuPIuIU0hWEZj6ndpb1uHYntw1_IVehAt2AmWBIUE=)**
I’ll level with you: Winning in a state as purple as New Hampshire isn’t easy even under the most favorable conditions. **And these are certainly not the most favorable conditions.** Whether it's the difficult political environment or the over $25 million the GOP is spending on smearing me, there has never been a more important time to have the resources to fight back.
**[And that takes people just like you, friend, chipping in $3 or whatever they can to help us fund the kind of campaign that can overcome the toughest odds.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49881099/363835771/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1501-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMjU4YWNlMi0xMDI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hwyuPIuIU0hWEZj6ndpb1uHYntw1_IVehAt2AmWBIUE=)**
I have never been one to back down from a challenge, and winning this race is certainly going to be one, but I am confident that with the support of people like you, we can win.
With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

I can’t do this alone.
#
Peter,
Whether I’m here in Washington state or working in the other Washington, I am always thinking about how I can best help families like yours. Bringing down health care costs. Taking action on climate. Protecting reproductive freedom. All of these issues and more are so important.
Today, I’m also thinking about the next election, and here’s why: **Republicans have dumped over a million dollars into attacking me in TV ads across the state — and now, they are pointing to a new poll that shows a single digit race for this pivotal U.S. Senate seat.**
**[There are only a few days left until we close the books on our August fundraising, so I am personally asking: will you contribute $5 or more toward our end-of-month goal?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49882112/363838786/1556387294?refcode=pm_em_220828_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOGU4ODhhNi0xNDI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GFAPJwBwInaZguZFAgOT5DMxVatWpNJc96vbyYEPmHM=)**
I’m doing everything I can to ensure Democrats hold this seat and keep our majority. But I can’t do it alone. I need supporters like you to step up and make sure we don’t lose our momentum.
Every member of this team has an important role to play. No matter how big or small, any amount of support you can give is so important to meeting our can’t-miss August fundraising goals.

Team,
This week, my opponent removed any mention of choice from his website – attempting to hide his "100% pro-life, no exceptions" stance .
Here’s what he had to say in the Detroit News:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220828.2&amount=28 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220828.2&amount=28]
According to him, it’s not an issue that’s important to voters . He says the update was simply “based upon the issues that were most salient right now.”
Either he’s not actually meeting with voters, or he’s not listening to them — particularly women from his own party. What I’m hearing every day is that Michiganders care deeply about personal freedom — and his 20+ years of positioning on this issue, not to mention introducing legislation to further restrict choice, can’t be hidden away now that he’s feeling the heat of a tough race.
Since the beginning of his campaign, he’s fundraised off of being “100% pro-life. No exceptions.”
Not rape. Not incest. Not the mental or physical health of the mother. It’s simply out of step with most Michiganders.
You don’t get to spend your entire political career touting your extreme views, only to try to hide them in the 11th hour.
This is what we’re up against in one of the toughest races in the country. Given that, please consider making a contribution today to help us continue talking to Michiganders about our freedoms at stake.

Instead, Rick Caruso is trying to buy his way into office with his deep pockets, hollow promises, and weak solutions. He's now up to $45 million on his own campaign. Los Angeles deserves better than that, team. August has been a slow month for fundraising – our team expected this. But to stay on track with our fundraising goal, we’ll need one last push from supporters like you. Can I count on you to donate whatever you are able to my campaign before Wednesday's end-of-month deadline? With your help, we'll compete with Rick Caruso’s spending and WIN this November — here's a link to donate: I’m so thankful for the outpouring of support from this team. As cliché as it may sound, I couldn’t be here without you. -KB Sent from my iPhone Paid for by Karen Bass for Mayor 2022 (ID # 1441328) Paid for by Karen Bass for Mayor 2022 777 S Figueroa St STE 4050 Los Angeles, CA 90017 United States Additional information is available at . | | ---|---|--- We rely on this email to communicate with this grassroots team, but if you no longer want to receive our emails, please .

| Unite T.V. Ad is on the Air!
This past week, Vikram Mansharamani released a bold new T.V. ad entitled Unite, in which he describes how the ideals of the American Revolution have been replaced by a Cultural Revolution that is tearing this nation apart.
The ripples of this destruction are seeping through daily life. The new revolutionaries are removing statues of our Founding Fathers, hosting segregated graduations based on race and social class, and suggesting kids should choose their own genders. Unity and equality are being replaced with division and equity.
On release of the captivating new spot, Mansharamani noted: "America is being torn apart from an agenda that is pitting people against each other, neighbor vs. neighbor. The situation is grim and I believe we're at a tipping point. We need to arrest this decline into divisive identity politics and I'm optimistic I can lead that charge."
The ad is being featured on WMUR and cable with a six-figure buy.

| World Affairs Council of New Hampshire Interview
Vikram sat down with Tim Horgan of WACNH to discuss some of the most pressing international issues that will face U.S. Senators over the course of the next few years. Peter –
Yesterday, I had the opportunity to be a featured speaker at the Georgia Democratic State Convention.
I spoke about the importance of serving the people, finding common-sense solutions, fighting corruption, and standing up for what’s right.
I spoke about what I’m running for – lowering health care costs, defending Medicare and Social Security, bringing jobs to the First District, restoring women’s reproductive rights, and protecting fair elections.
I spoke about who I’m running against – a career politician who has used his thirty-plus years in politics to serve his own interests & enrich himself while neglecting the needs of the First District.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem0828 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem0828]

I’m thankful for our dedicated team and supporters who are powering our efforts throughout the district.
This week, you’ll hear a few times from my team about our end-of-month fundraising goal. While fundraising is not my favorite part of being a candidate, it’s necessary.
We are going up against Buddy Carter’s $2 million war chest, and our August fundraising goal is ambitious yet attainable.

| San Diego is proud to be home to the largest population of veterans and military service members in the country. And as a proud military community, we deeply understand the value of service and the immense sacrifice of our military members and their families.

That’s why Sara is proud to have supported the most significant expansion of benefits and services for veterans in more than 30 years. The act will expand health care services for veterans exposed to toxic substances and codify a new review process for establishing presumption of toxic exposure.

This is an important step towards supporting our military community. She stands committed to deliver for veterans and military families here in our district and across the country.

With gratitude,

Team SJ

We’ve sent you dozens of messages defining our race like this:

_“It’s a battleground district!”
“This race is a tossup!”
“We’re in a must-win race!”_

Now, this race is all of those things, but let me explain what it really means:
* A few months ago, **National Republicans dumped $2.5 million into this district** to help Rep. Chabot return to Congress for his 27th & 28th years.

* **There has been a massive shift in favor of Democrats** after the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_. Families know Republican Rep. Chabot is _too extreme_ for our communities.

Friend,

Thanks to folks like you, my good friend Sen. Rev. Raphael Warnock beat the odds last year and prevailed in one of the most consequential runoff elections in U.S. history – ultimately helping Democrats take back the Senate.
Ever since, Raphael has shown our nation just how much elections truly matter. Because of his leadership and our narrow majority, we've been able to provide crucial pandemic relief for struggling families, create millions of good-paying jobs, and turn the page on the cruelty of the most divisive president of our lifetime.
**But with so much left to do, experts at _NPR_ recently ranked Raphael's seat as the most likely to flip red – and _FiveThirtyEight_ confirms that his race in Georgia could determine Senate control. That's why the GOP is coming after him as its TOP target for defeat. There's no question that Raphael can beat the odds once again this November, but _only_ with your grassroots support.**

Raphael is Georgia's first Black senator in history – the _only _other Black Democrat in the Senate besides myself – and he's exactly the kind of strong, moral leader that our country needs more of in Washington.
**With our entire Democratic agenda – from voting rights to reproductive freedoms – on the line, we need to keep Raphael in the Senate. But the GOP is flooding this race with _millions_ to flip his seat, and polling shows him 1 point down. **

name: John Grisham
subject: Corporate interests and billionaires are throwing money into NC to defeat Cheri Beasley and uphold a corrupt, broken system.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
It’s John Grisham, reaching out on behalf of the woman I hope we will elect as North Carolina’s next Senator, Cheri Beasley.
#

Hey there,
It’s John Grisham, reaching out on behalf of the woman I hope we will elect as North Carolina’s next Senator, Cheri Beasley.
I spend a lot of time thinking and writing about justice in this country — and how often it is out of reach for working people, particularly in poor communities and communities of color.
The truth is that the status quo is tilted in favor of the wealthy and well-connected, and it’s no accident.
We have corporate interests and billionaires throwing money in to make it that way. This is how Republicans try to win and hold power. Limitless sums of cash just pour into super PACs that try to buy races like Cheri’s.
And they mostly do this by running a bunch of misleading attack ads. The ones we’ve seen against Cheri are straight out of this playbook. The lies about her record as a judge are an astounding distortion of the truth.
Cheri is committed to changing that and being a voice for the people, but she needs our help to take on the corrupt dark money that’s flooding North Carolina.
[**Will you please join me by making a contribution to Cheri Beasley’s campaign for U.S. Senate today? We cannot expect our broken system to fix itself. We have to fight for it.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220828-3-ma&t=1&akid=1580%2E357359%2E32LIQe)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220828-3-ma&t=2&akid=1580%2E357359%2E32LIQe)**
Cheri’s campaign is personally important to me, and I think it stands as one of our best chances to move the needle on creating a more just country.
First, I care deeply about North Carolina. My wife was born in Raleigh, and my family is full of Tar Heels. I know that this state deserves a leader like Cheri representing them in the U.S. Senate.
Cheri would provide one of the most important and impactful voices in Washington. She is undeniably qualified with her wealth of experience as a public defender, judge, and Chief Justice of North Carolina’s Supreme Court. She will also bring an important perspective to the Senate Chamber that currently has zero African American women serving.
She has a deep understanding of what’s not working and has proven that she is relentless in her pursuit of justice for the people. Electing Cheri is our best chance to expand the majority in a way that can meaningfully change what’s broken in our country.
I know we can trust her to stand up to the special interests that thrive off Washington gridlock and corruption. There’s a reason they are spending millions of dollars to stop her, and she needs our help to fight back.
[**So if you can, please consider making a contribution to Cheri’s campaign today to win North Carolina. It’s going to take a lot of us chipping in what we can to take on the corrupt interests trying to buy this seat.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220828-3-ma&t=3&akid=1580%2E357359%2E32LIQe)

****
Thank you for standing with Cheri Beasley and helping us bend the arc toward justice.

John Grisham

| | | | | Peter, the fate of the nation may hang on which Florida man becomes governor of the state this November. **And Ron DeSantis has turned Florida—and America—into a danger zone.** **A clownish, crude and colic disgrace to Florida. The examples are endless.** His firing Rebekah Jones from the Health Dept--as we've written you about--for keeping accurate COVID numbers, ones that would show how many Floridians he actually allowed to get sick and die by ignoring the crisis (Florida ended up suffering more than any other state). He sent state officers into her home, to point guns at her children and threaten her, when he found out she was continuing to keep track of COVID numbers on her own. DeSantis punished Disney for being inclusive to the gay & lesbian community, he punished the Tampa Bay Rays for sharing accurate information on gun violence via their Twitter feed and, most recently, he suspended a Tampa prosecutor, Adam Warren, who said he wouldn't prosecute abortion cases because the state's previous laws on privacy and abortion are still unclear. **[So can you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Charlie Crist, so we can stop the totalitarian DeSantis from further destroying Florida, and ever getting his grubby little hands on the United States?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3f3ce48a-9b05-4bb5-b5d5-8f30f96ab3d7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **DeSantis is dictatorial, degrading and an enemy of American democracy. **_But even all of that couldn't prepare us for the video he just released "Top Gov," a takeoff on Top Gun so cringe-inducing that it's impossible to watch and not keel over from second-hand embarrassment. _ _DeSantis puts on a flight suit to--which is stolen valor, he was a military lawyer, but he never served in combat--and a helmet on his oversized nugget that is so tight it makes it look like he's squeezing a melon through hoop earring. _ **_DeSantis is as unserious as he is evil, and if we don't stop him now, he will have a good shot at being President in 2024, as lunatics like Alex Jones--who, sadly, have a ton of influence in today's GOP--line up behind him._** _**The winner of the Democratic primary in Florida, Charlie Crist is a well-known entity in Florida. A never Trumper before it was cool, he left the GOP when the Tea Party wave of 2010 produced such right wing reactionaries--like Marco Rubio--it was clear to him the GOP was no longer his party. **_
